proposal_identity.provenance: All exact formulas are newly authored proposal definitions, not recovered GP V1.1 formulas.

common_mapping.missing_behavior: Reject; no forward fill, substitution, or proxy inputs
common_mapping.numeric_behavior: All numeric values must be finite; booleans are not numeric inputs

input_contract.daily_history: Exactly 121 explicit, strictly increasing, one-to-one aligned market-calendar rows ending on the Asia/Shanghai snapshot date
input_contract.intraday_history: Exactly five closed 15-minute bars and five closed 60-minute bars, kept separate from daily history
input_contract.availability: Every value must be known no later than snapshot as_of and daily rows no earlier than their Asia/Shanghai 15:00 close
input_contract.source_ids: Nonempty caller-declared trace references for every input family; identifiers alone are not cryptographic or substantive provenance verification

factors.name: market_regime
factors.neutral_case: Both returns zero gives raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Uses only daily rows through snapshot date

factors.name: market_breadth
factors.unit: breadth ratio in [0,1] mapped to signed dimensionless raw value
factors.neutral_case: Five-day mean breadth 0.5 gives raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Uses only breadth known by snapshot as_of

factors.name: sector_rs
factors.neutral_case: Equal sector and market returns give raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Uses only daily rows through snapshot date

factors.name: sector_slope_r2
factors.unit: dimensionless normalized log-price slope weighted by fit R-squared
factors.neutral_case: Constant series has slope zero and R-squared zero
factors.point_in_time: Uses only daily rows through snapshot date

factors.name: sector_breadth
factors.unit: breadth ratio in [0,1] mapped to signed dimensionless raw value
factors.neutral_case: Five-day mean breadth 0.5 gives raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Uses only breadth known by snapshot as_of

factors.name: position
factors.unit: signed dimensionless range location rewarding lower position
factors.neutral_case: A constant window uses location 0.5; all constant windows give raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Uses only daily rows through snapshot date; ranking separately requires positive 20-session momentum

factors.name: multi_momentum
factors.neutral_case: All returns zero gives raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Uses only daily rows through snapshot date

factors.name: trend_quality
factors.unit: dimensionless normalized log-price slope weighted by fit R-squared
factors.neutral_case: Constant series has slope zero and R-squared zero
factors.point_in_time: Uses only daily rows through snapshot date

factors.name: efficiency_ratio
factors.neutral_case: Zero path length gives raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Uses 21 observed daily closes through snapshot date

factors.name: drawdown_recovery
factors.formula: In close[-60:], locate the latest maximum, take the minimum from that peak through current, then 2*(current-trough)/(peak-trough)-1
factors.unit: signed dimensionless recovery from post-peak trough
factors.neutral_case: Peak equal to trough gives raw zero; an increasing path ending at its latest peak is neutral
factors.point_in_time: Uses only daily rows through snapshot date

factors.name: price_fund_efficiency
factors.formula: efficiency=r(stock_close,5)/sum(turnover_ratio[-5:]); daily_intensity=clip(main_net_flow_cny/amount_cny/0.20)*0.20; net_mean=mean(daily_intensity[-5:]); persistence=fraction of five raw flow values with same nonzero sign as net_mean, or zero when net_mean is zero; raw=mean(efficiency/0.10,net_mean/0.05*persistence)
factors.unit: dimensionless normalized price efficiency and capped flow intensity
factors.neutral_case: Zero return and zero flows gives raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Caps each daily flow pulse before averaging and uses only daily rows through snapshot date

factors.name: intraday_confirmation
factors.neutral_case: No change in both intraday series gives raw zero and score 50
factors.point_in_time: Exactly five separately identified closed bars per timeframe, each known by snapshot as_of; no post-signal availability is inferred
